name: The Chain Veil
oracle_text:
At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't activate a loyalty ability of a planeswalker this turn, you lose 2 life.
{4}, {T}: For each planeswalker you control, you may activate one of its loyalty abilities once this turn as though none of its loyalty abilities have been activated this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, if you didn't activate a loyalty ability of a planeswalker this turn, you lose 2 life.
{4}, {T}: For each planeswalker you control, you may activate one of its loyalty abilities once this turn as though none of its loyalty abilities have been activated this turn.

needs.what: a per-player turn ledger value counting how many loyalty abilities of planeswalkers that player activated this turn (e.g. {"loyalty_activations_this_turn": "you"}), usable as an intervening-if condition on an end_step trigger compared against 0
needs.why_existing_wont_do: value_keys has spells_cast_this_turn, life_gained_this_turn, cards_drawn_this_turn etc. but nothing counting loyalty activations; has_turn_flag would need every planeswalker's loyalty cost to set a flag, which no card-level mechanism does, and an ability_activated trigger setting a flag would be an unprinted helper trigger that also misses activations before The Chain Veil entered

needs.what: an op granting, for each planeswalker you control, one additional loyalty-ability activation this turn that ignores the once-per-turn loyalty limit (rule 606.3), usable once per planeswalker per resolution
needs.why_existing_wont_do: the static activate_loyalty_as_though_instant only changes timing, not the once-per-turn count; no op in reference touches the loyalty activation limit
